from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    comps = []
    seen = set()
    for r in range(sep):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < sep and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            comps.append(cells)
    chosen = max(comps, key=lambda cells: max(x for y,x in cells))
    bottom = [(r-sep-1, c) for r in range(sep+1,h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[sep+1:]]
    by0 = min(y for y,x in bottom)
    bx0 = min(x for y,x in bottom)
    oy0 = by0 - (max(y for y,x in chosen) - min(y for y,x in chosen) + 1)
    cy0, cx0 = min(y for y,x in chosen), min(x for y,x in chosen)
    color = grid[chosen[0][0]][chosen[0][1]]
    for y,x in chosen:
        yy, xx = oy0 + (y-cy0), bx0 + (x-cx0)
        if 0 <= yy < len(out) and 0 <= xx < w:
            out[yy][xx] = color
    return out
